title: Minuta 2025-11-06
summary: The minutes of the 6 November decision (a fourth consecutive 25bp cut to 7.25%, again split 4-1 with Heath dissenting for a hold at 7.50%) keep the board on its gradual easing path, but the collegial tone reads modestly LESS dovish than the September minutes. The key change is the forward guidance: the board dropped the prior 'valorara recortes adicionales' and now only says it 'valorara recortar la tasa de referencia', with two members (Heath and one aligned) explicitly arguing the guidance must be modified so it stops pre-committing to further cuts and instead signals full data-dependence and an unconditional commitment to the 3% point target rather than merely staying inside the variability range. The dovish pillars are, if anything, stronger: activity outright contracted in Q3 with the output gap widening in negative territory, domestic demand (consumption and fixed investment) is clearly weakening, the labor market keeps cooling and wages moderating, the peso is up ~12% year-to-date and the Fed's cutting cycle gives room 'without compressing the differential'. The persistent counterweight is unchanged and now flagged more sharply: core inflation is stuck around 4.24% with above-anticipated persistence, its forecast was revised up again, the whole board judges the inflation balance of risks still tilted up (though 'less pronounced than 2021-2024'), and members note the real ex-ante rate (~3.36%) has reached the upper range of neutrality (midpoint 2.7%), leaving limited room. A new one-off upside is the IEPS tax increase, seen as transitory. Net, the board is still cutting gradually with the door open, but the softened guidance and the caution camp tilt it a touch back from the September minutes.

key_quotes.quote: la Junta de Gobierno, con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por mayoría reducir en 25 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 7.25%.
key_quotes.context: Collegial decision: fourth straight 25bp cut to 7.25% by majority, one dissent (Heath, hold at 7.50%)

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortar la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Softened forward guidance: 'will weigh cutting', dropping the prior 'valorara recortes adicionales' and no longer pre-committing to further cuts

key_quotes.quote: Todos consideraron que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous read that the inflation balance of risks stays tilted up; the majority adds it is less pronounced than in 2021-2024

key_quotes.quote: La mayoría señaló que la contracción de la actividad fue producto de la caída de la producción industrial.
key_quotes.context: Majority on the Q3 activity contraction driven by falling industrial output; output gap widening in negative territory
